files: Fischer et al. - 2016 - Polymorphisms of Dectin-1 and TLR2 Predispose to Invasive Fungal Disease in Patients with Acute Myel.pdf

rows.comparison_as_reported: TLR2 wild type vs. TLR2 R753Q rs5743708
rows.subgroup: Pulmonary IFD (possible, probable and proven), all AML patients
rows.note: OR refers to R753Q carriers (GA/AA, n=12) vs wild type; table prints the reference group first. Table 2: 7 of 12 carriers had pulmonary IFD; GA and AA not separated, so genotype counts left null. Alleles taken from abstract 'GA/AA genotype'.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Dectin-1 wild type** vs. Dectin-1 Y238X rs16910526
rows.subgroup: Pulmonary IFD (possible, probable and proven), all AML patients
rows.note: Table 3 prints OR 0.7 with p 'n.s.'; CI and p from text. OR refers to Y238X carriers (n=19) vs wild type (defined as negativity of Y238X allele). Allele labels from S2 Fig (wildtype A/A, heterozygous A/C). Table 2: 4 of 19 carriers had IFD; genotypes not separated.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Dectin-1 C/C + C/G vs. Dectin-1 rs7309123 G/G genotype
rows.subgroup: Pulmonary IFD (possible, probable and proven), all AML patients
rows.note: OR for G/G (n=47) vs C/C+C/G. Paper does not use the word 'recessive'; model assigned from grouping. Table 2: 19 (40%) of 47 G/G patients had pulmonary IFD; 40 of 133 C/G+G/G; other genotype counts not printed separately.

rows.comparison_as_reported: Dectin-1 C/C vs. Dectin-1 rs7309123 G/G + C/G genotype
rows.subgroup: Pulmonary IFD (possible, probable and proven), all AML patients
rows.note: OR for G carriers (G/G + C/G, n=133) vs C/C. Paper does not use word 'dominant'. Table 2: 40 (30%) of 133 carriers had IFD, 19 of 47 G/G; separate C/G and C/C case counts not printed.

rows.verbatim_source: the G/G genotype of the Dectin-1 rs7309123 SNP is also significantly associated with the risk of probable and proven IFD
rows.note: Numbers are in S1 Table, which is not included. Table 2: probable/proven IFD in 5 (11%) of 47 G/G, 9 (7%) of 133 C/G+G/G, 2 (17%) of 12 TLR2 R753Q, 0 of 19 Y238X; 9 total.

rows.variant_name_as_reported: TLR2 R753Q or Dectin-1 rs7309123 G/G genotype (Cohort 1)
rows.comparison_as_reported: Cohort 1: TLR2 R753Q or Dectin-1 rs7309123 G/G genotype vs Cohort 2: TLR2 wild type Dectin-1 rs7309123 C/C + C/G genotype
rows.subgroup: Pulmonary IFD (possible, probable and proven), all AML patients
rows.note: Combined genotype subgroup analysis of two listed variants; IFD 42% in cohort 1 vs 19% in cohort 2. Methods state ORs from multiple logistic regression but Table 4 adjustment not explicitly stated.

paper_note: Fischer 2016 PLoS ONE: 186 AML patients on induction chemotherapy, 48 pulmonary IFD (mostly possible); adjusted ORs from multiple logistic regression; pneumonia/atypical pneumonia outcomes excluded; rs3901533 excluded by authors due to low frequency.
